tool.name: Sparcc
tool.description: Calculate correlations between OTUs with the SparCC algorithm

param.name: label
param.label: label - select OTU distance labels
param.help: all labels are used if none are selected

param.name: groups
param.label: groups - Groups to include
param.help: all groups are used if none are selected

param.label: samplings - number of times to resample the data
permutations - number of permutations used to estimate the p-values
param.help: Default 1000. This dominates the run time of the tool

param.label: method - how the resampled datasets are generated
param.option: dirichlet - draw the abundances from a Dirichlet distribution (default)
relabund - use the relative abundances directly

tool.help:
@MOTHUR_OVERVIEW@
**Command Documentation**
The sparcc_ command implements the SParse Correlations for Compositional data (SparCC) algorithm to infer the correlation network between OTUs from a shared_ file. Compositional data such as OTU abundances are constrained to a constant sum, which induces spurious correlations; SparCC accounts for that by re-estimating the correlations from the log-ratios of the component abundances.
To judge the significance of the correlations the data are resampled `samplings_` times, and for every resampled dataset the correlations are recalculated `iterations` times and compared to `permutations` permuted datasets. All three parameters dominate the run time of the command.
Three tables are produced for every label of the shared file: the average relative abundances (`sparcc_relabund`), the correlation matrix (`sparcc_correlation`) and the corresponding p-value matrix (`sparcc_pvalue`).
.. _sparcc: https://mothur.org/wiki/sparcc/ .. _samplings: https://mothur.org/wiki/sparcc/#samplings .. _iterations: https://mothur.org/wiki/sparcc/#iterations .. _permutations: https://mothur.org/wiki/sparcc/#permutations .. _shared: https://mothur.org/wiki/shared_file/
